description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'CustomFieldModelTest' for testing the 'CustomFieldModel' class in the OrangeHRM project. It specifically tests the 'toArray' method to ensure it correctly serializes a 'CustomField' entity to an associative array.

classes.name: CustomFieldModelTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of CustomFieldModel, especially the toArray method.

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Tests the toArray method of CustomFieldModel to check if it correctly converts a CustomField entity to an array representation.
